about: The coal yard where the East Rise coal ends: a buyer behind a counter with a premium buyer on it, coal heaps, a hopper, a truck bay, work lights and a sign, on open ground beside a power plant. No building hosts it, so the slot is hostless: its kit rests on the probed ground of one free plot. Same shape as coal-seam.json, with the map mark as a `WholesaleCounter` place. Tooling data: no coordinates and no place names.
